description: This file defines the implementation of the 'Mcu' class, which manages MCU (Microcontroller Unit) dependencies within the Cuttlefish virtual machine environment. It includes methods for setting up directories, generating commands, checking availability, and integrating with dependency injection frameworks.

classes.name: Mcu
classes.description: A class that manages MCU dependencies, including setup, command generation, and status checking within the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Sets up the MCU directory if the MCU is enabled.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates the commands to start the MCU based on configuration.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the feature, 'MCU'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the MCU feature is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: WaitForAvailability
methods.description: Waits for the MCU to become available by checking specific files.
